quote: The casualty reporting procedures for DCIPS 8.0 are no longer in effect.
fix: Cite MARADMIN 186/25 for casualty reporting. It makes the DCIPS-PCR spreadsheet the sole method. The supersession flag on MCO 3040.4 is a false positive. 186/25 cancels MARADMIN 226/07, not the order.

claim: The 8-hour PCR window applies to casualty actions
quote: The timeframe for submitting the required voice report has been shortened from one hour to 30 minutes.
fix: Replace with: voice report to MFPC within 30 minutes, then the DCIPS-PCR template to casualty.section@usmc.mil within one hour. MCO 3040.4 uses 8 hours only as the goal for finishing next-of-kin notification.

claim: OMPF operational service documentation falls under MCO P1070.12K Chapter 6
quote: CHAPTER 6 ABBREVIATIONS AND ACRONYMS
fix: Chapter 6 holds abbreviations. Cite chapter 4 (SRB) or chapter 1 (headquarters file contents) and name the paragraph.

quote: The purpose of this PAA is to provide clarification to paragraphs 4006.3r and 4006.3x of reference (a).

claim: Three components of administration
quote: The three components of administration are the Active Component (AC), the Reserve Component (RC), and the civilian component.

claim: Six lines of operation tied together by support

quote: Processing naval correspondence. Managing casualty assistance procedures. Managing the awards program. Supervising postal affairs.

quote: Managing personnel assignments, operating levels, and staffing and developing sourcing solutions for permanent manpower requirements.

quote: Maintaining electronic personnel and pay records.
